name: SERNKOU
recent: Sern Kou 于 2026 年 9 月底宣布其子公司将停止胶合板制造业务，该业务此前处于亏损状态。随后在 11 月 20 日召开的第 26 届年度股东大会上，所有决议均获通过。同期，董事经理 Low Peng Sian 在 11 月 16 日及 19 日合计减持约 2,100 万股。
notable: 子公司停止胶合板制造业务。
第 26 届年度股东大会所有决议获通过。
Kenanga 旗下伊斯兰基金成为持股 11.17% 的大股东。
risks: 董事经理 Low Peng Sian 在 11 月 16 日及 19 日合计减持约 2,100 万股。
公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净亏损 1,589 万令吉，亏损较上一季度扩大。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 1.115 亿令吉，环比增长 16.3%，但同比下降 25.0%；净亏损 1,589 万令吉，净亏损率为 14.3%，而上一季度净亏损率为 5.6%。

recent_en: Sern Kou announced in late September 2026 that its subsidiary will cease plywood manufacturing operations, which had been loss-making. Subsequently, all resolutions were passed at its 26th AGM held on 20 November. Meanwhile, Managing Director Low Peng Sian disposed of approximately 21 million shares in total on 16 and 19 November.
notable_en: Subsidiary to cease plywood manufacturing operations.
All resolutions passed at the 26th AGM.
Kenanga's Islamic fund emerged as a substantial shareholder with an 11.17% stake.
risks_en: Managing Director Low Peng Sian disposed of approximately 21 million shares in total on 16 and 19 November.
The company recorded a net loss of RM15.89 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with the loss widening from the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM111.5 million, up 16.3% QoQ but down 25.0% YoY; net loss was RM15.89 million with a net loss margin of 14.3%, compared to a net loss margin of 5.6% in the previous quarter.
